shortDescription: French energy major TotalEnergies EURONEXT:TTE said on Friday it had signed an agreement for BlackRock's NYSE:BLK Global Infrastructure Partners to invest in its African oil and gas infrastructure assets.In exchange for the fund's $1.8 billion (€1.6 billion) capital contribution, TotalEnergies will…

children: said on Friday it had signed an agreement for BlackRock's
Global Infrastructure Partners to invest in its African oil and gas infrastructure assets.

In exchange for the fund's $1.8 billion (€1.6 billion) capital contribution, TotalEnergies will pay GIP a recurring fee based on the volume of oil and gas passing through the facilities for up to 15 years, it said.
